mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect partly cloudy skies and a warm 91 degrees near Harriet Park, though please note the moderate air quality index of 54 today.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet August 3rd at 6:30 p.m. to review several projects, including a 4,700 square foot addition at 201 South Main Street and a new pickleball court facility.
Today you can head over to Insight Wellness for yoga, and keep an eye out for tomorrow, which is packed with trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Louie.
A noteworthy call occurred on Sunday, July 26th, when an officer stopped a vehicle traveling 97 miles per hour on the highway and subsequently arrested the driver for an O-W-I.
Today is the perfect day for our flavor of the day, Snickers Swirl, so head on over to Culver's of Verona before they close their doors at 10:00 PM tonight.
